title: Huong dan khai thue thu nhap ca nhan qua mang nam 2026
content_markdown:
## Nop ho so khai thue dien tu

Tu nam 2024, tat ca ca nhan co thu nhap tu kinh doanh deu phai nop ho so khai thue qua he thong dien tu.

## Cach thuc nop

### Buoc 1: Dang ky tai khoan
- Truy cap website: Thue dien tu
- Dang ky tai khoan voi ma so thue

### Buoc 2: Chuan bi ho so
- To khai thue TNCN (mau 02/KK-TNCN)
- Bang ke chi tiet thu nhap
- Cac chung tu khau tru thue (neu co)

### Buoc 3: Nop va theo doi
- Nop ho so qua cong thue dien tu
- Nhan thong bao xu ly qua email
- In thong bao thue de nop tien

## Thoi han nop

- Khai thue thang: truoc ngay 20 hang thang
- Khai thue quy: truoc ngay 30 thang dau quy sau
- Quyet toan nam: truoc ngay 31/03 nam sau
